history.period: 21st century (exact inauguration year not found - verify)
history.summary: Identity confirmed: a modern Hindu temple at Road No. 5, Gangasthan Phase 2, Nizamabad (PIN 503003), inaugurated by His Holiness Sri Ganapathy Sachchidananda Swamiji. The main deity is Sri Venkateswara Swamy, with sub-shrines for Vinayaka Swamy, Lakshmi Devi, Lord Siva, Dattatreya Swamy and Karya Siddhi Hanuman. Rated ~4.8/5 across review sites with several hundred reviews. No ancient history or dynasty associated; festival calendar details are not published online.

name: Uttara Tirupati Kshetram
town_description: Gangasthan Phase 2 is a residential locality in Nizamabad city, Telangana, where the temple stands on Road No. 5. Wheelchair-accessible entrance and car park are reported.
tradition: Hinduism (Vaishnava, Sri Venkateswara; inaugurated under the lineage of Sri Ganapathy Sachchidananda Swamiji)

travel.road: Within Nizamabad city at Road No. 5, Gangasthan Phase 2; cab or auto.
